name: Magus Dragon Night
body:
A dragon knight belongs to a respected order that uses magic, sword, and the help of drake allies to protect law, good, and the peoples of the world from all threats external and internal.

Drake Ally

At 3rd level, the dragon knight gains a drake companion. His effective charge level for this ability is equal to his magus level. This ability replaces heavy armor, the magus’ bonus feats, and the arcana gained at 3rd, 9th, and 15th level.

A dragon knight can never gain a familiar.
